macro_cross_check: PASSES THE BAND, and only after a corrected each-weight. With chicken at the source's stated 300 g and the noodles on a hydrated basis, per serving at 2 servings: 365 cal, 43.7 g protein, 34.5 g carbs, against the source's published 357 / 41.6 / 33.8 - agreement within 2%, 5% and 2%. Band: 350-650 cal ok, protein >= 40 ok, carbs <= 35 ok but TIGHT at 34.5. Now the catch this check exists for: the settled 200 g on 'up to 300g/10 oz' gives 306 cal and 32.5 g protein per serving, a 22% protein gap against the source and a fail on BOTH the 350 cal floor and the 40 g protein floor - a good dish retired on an each-weight assumption about the main protein. The source's own published macros can only be reached at about 300 g, so I set grams_source 300 and flagged it on the line.
